modmenu.descriptionTranslation.riatoriif: A mod that allows you to quickly query information about torii or precincts within the RIA server.
riatoriifind.command.help.find: /riatoriifind <ID or keyword> | Search for torii or precincts
riatoriifind.result.empty.find: No related torii or precinct information found
riatoriifind.result.col.name: Torii/Precinct Name
riatoriifind.error.no_session: No search results to page through; please perform a search first
riatoriifind.config.title: RiaToriiFind Configuration
riatoriifind.config.show_check_popups.to: When disabled, popups for successful or failed connections will not appear after switching remote data sources.
riatoriifind.config.source.tooltip:
Select the data source for querying torii information.

- Local data source: Uses the mod's built-in data, updated with mod updates, data may be lagging.
- RIA Wiki data source: Maintained by FleTime and hosted on the RIA Wiki, updated more promptly.
riatoriifind.config.refresh_source.toolt: When enabled, after clicking Done and exiting, this switch will automatically be reset and the current data source will be refreshed once.
riatoriifind.config.debug_mode.tooltip: When enabled, outputs detailed runtime information to the log for troubleshooting; no need to turn it on otherwise.
riatoriifind.source.check.success.title: Data source connection successful
riatoriifind.source.check.success.messag: Successfully retrieved data file from remote source.
riatoriifind.source.check.fallback.title: Data source connection failed
riatoriifind.source.check.fallback.messa: Unable to connect to remote source, switched to local data source.
